title.zh: ⚡️沃什发布会总结：不加息未受政治影响，明年秋季进行日程改革
title.en: ⚡️沃什发布会总结：不加息未受政治影响，明年秋季进行日程改革

current_state.zh: Fed Chair Warsh said politics played no role in the October FOMC's decision not to hike rates, warned that inflation remains elevated, and announced that from next fall the FOMC will restructure its eight annual meetings, with some sessions dedicated to policy strategy and no rate vote.
current_state.en: Fed Chair Warsh said politics played no role in the October FOMC's decision not to hike rates, warned that inflation remains elevated, and announced that from next fall the FOMC will restructure its eight annual meetings, with some sessions dedicated to policy strategy and no rate vote.
